description: Search for companies by name, ticker symbol or SEC CIK in the Signal8 database. Returns matching companies with their ticker, name, CIK, and exchange. A numeric query is matched as a CIK (`matchedBy: "cik"`). A ticker no company holds today is matched as a FORMER symbol of a renamed or delisted company (`matchedBy: "former_symbol"`, e.g. "MIGI" finds Big Digital Energy, now BGDE); a delisted company has `currentSymbol: null` and empty `tickers`.

query.description: Search query - company name, ticker symbol or CIK (e.g., "Tesla", "TSLA", "1318605"); 1-200 characters

name: search_companies
title: Search Companies
